2. Rust API: new parallel_sync.rs and additive export. supports_parallel_sync(&CapturedField<ArtifactModelVersions>) -> Result<bool,FactsUnavailable>. Bound input/error work without changing valid grammar.
3. Tests: additive tests/parallel_sync.rs. Complete original checkSupportsParallelSync nine literal assertions, original model Int.MIN major/minor and empty description, original named assertion messages; unavailable minimum consumer corresponds to original null and is not consulted. Additional exact AGP boundaries, model override and description independence, missing capability, invalid/unknown version precedence, historical preview spellings/Int bounds, and bounded long-input checks. Reuse original ModelVersionsTest fixture unchanged. Add exact AgpVersion source/license/notice fixtures only. Acceptance: every old test/fixture byte unchanged, no disabled/removed assertions.
4. Five independent static reviewers: correctness,UI,UX,performance,quality. Capacity coordinated with Root; no Cargo/Gradle/app during reviews. Preserve everyFAIL and fix evidence; after3 unsuccessful product rounds escalate before furtheredits.

No JVM/scheduler/runtime parallel Gradle claim; runtime proof is actual pureRust capability execution. Retain exact process-measurement harness source if measurements are taken; no IDE performance claim.
6. Affected reviewers inspect current runtime proof and give final fivePASS; release lease whencompiler/nativeactivity ends. Package owner report/evidence and one proposed unported/lead-capture-pending canonical row; matrix remains Root-owned. Normal commit/push ownbranch only after scopedgates.
